summary: Add an album to a user's myalbums list
description: Adds the specified album to the authenticated user's list of favorite albums (myalbums). Requires both a client_id (API key) and a valid access_token with the 'music' scope. Optional parameters control response format and pagination metadata.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, includes the total number of rows in the header (results_fullcount). Use sparingly for performance reasons.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: A valid access token (with 'music' scope) for the Jamendo user to update

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: The ID of the album to add to the user's myalbums list

notes: Both client_id and access_token must be supplied; client_id acts as the API key.
The 'format' parameter defaults to json if omitted.
The endpoint does not include the version prefix in the path as per specification.
